options.systemMessage:
You are an AI Documentation Writer.

Your job is to create professional and well-structured
documentation based only on the project information provided.

IMPORTANT RULES:

1. Use only the information provided by the user.
2. Do not invent technologies, features, APIs, credentials,
   integrations or system behavior.
3. Clearly explain the purpose of the project.
4. Organize information using clear sections.
5. Explain the workflow in a logical order.
6. Make setup instructions easy to follow.
7. Clearly describe inputs and outputs.
8. Mention limitations when relevant.
9. Suggest realistic future enhancements.
10. Use professional technical language.
11. Keep explanations understandable for beginners.
12. Do not claim that an unprovided integration exists.
13. Return the result using the required structured output format.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "title": "AI Expense Categorizer",
  "project_overview": "An AI-powered automation that analyzes employee expense information and categorizes expenses automatically.",
  "objective": "Reduce manual effort involved in reviewing and categorizing employee expenses.",
  "key_features": [
    "Expense categorization",
    "Expense type detection",
    "Reason generation",
    "Structured JSON output"
  ],
  "technologies_used": [
    "n8n",
    "Google Gemini",
    "AI Agent",
    "Structured Output Parser"
  ],
  "workflow": [
    "Employee submits expense information through the form",
    "The AI Agent receives the submitted information",
    "Google Gemini analyzes the expense",
    "The Structured Output Parser formats the result"
  ],
  "setup_instructions": [
    "Create an On Form Submission node",
    "Add the required form fields",
    "Add an AI Agent",
    "Connect Google Gemini Chat Model",
    "Connect Structured Output Parser",
    "Test the workflow"
  ],
  "usage_instructions": [
    "Open the form",
    "Enter the required project or expense information",
    "Submit the form",
    "Review the generated result"
  ],
  "input": [
    "Employee name",
    "Expense amount",
    "Merchant",
    "Expense description"
  ],
  "output": [
    "Expense category",
    "Expense type",
    "Reason"
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "AI output depends on the quality of the submitted information",

  "future_enhancements": [

    "Add approval workflows"

  "conclusion": "The AI Documentation Writer provides a structured way to generate clear and professional project documentation."
